description: The alternative and definition tag clauses both contain failing queries. Either failure ends the parse with a grammar error, so the case pins the error kind rather than its wording (engine §3.7, §4).
grammar:
%rule text (A x)
%rule x :: $.tags(x) | B :: $.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault)


%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
